mapper.sql: id, doctor_id, department_id, schedule_date, period, period_start, period_end, total_slots, slot_duration, register_fee, status, audit_status, fee_type, overbook, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (doctor_id, department_id, schedule_date, period, period_start, period_end, total_slots, slot_duration, register_fee, status, audit_status, fee_type, overbook, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{departmentId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{period}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{totalSlots}, #{slotDuration}, #{registerFee}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1), COALESCE(#{auditStatus}, 'PENDING'), COALESCE(#{feeType}, 'NORMAL'), COALESCE(#{overbook}, 0), SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM schedule WHERE audit_status = #{auditStatus} ORDER BY schedule_date ASC, period ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET status = #{status}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE schedule SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE schedule SET overbook = #{overbook}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE schedule SET fee_type = #{feeType}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
